article.headline: Delaware State opens season with an 86-52 win over Saint Vincent
article.description: — Nehemiah Reedus scored 19 points as Delaware State opened its campaign Monday with an 86-52 victory over Saint Vincent.
article.linkText: Delaware State opens season with an 86-52 win over Saint Vincent

categories.description: Saint Vincent Bearcats @ Delaware State Hornets

event.description: Saint Vincent Bearcats @ Delaware State Hornets

keywords: Saint Vincent Bearcats @ Delaware State Hornets
article.story: DOVER, Del. -- — Nehemiah Reedus scored 19 points as Delaware State opened its campaign Monday with an 86-52 victory over Saint Vincent. Reedus had five rebounds and four steals for the Hornets. Nasir Muhammad added 18 points while going 7 for 11 from the field, including 4 for 7 from 3-point range, and grabbed five rebounds. Isaiah Sullivan shot 6 for 15 from the field, including 3 for 7 from beyond the arc, to finish with 16 points. Terek Crosby led the Bearcats with 11 points. Isaac Cherry added eight points for Saint Vincent. Duncan Spalding finished with seven points. Up next Delaware State visits Navy on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
